scope: Authenticated business APIs outside Agent Work, CRM, and Documents
rules: Every included operation must be exposed through a narrow Agent Work adapter, never by forwarding the OAuth token to an application route.
Firm scope is mandatory; person, relationship, company, thread, job, and delivery identifiers must also be checked against that firm before use.
Secrets, public or invite tokens, storage coordinates, signer IP addresses, and raw upstream payloads must be removed from MCP responses.

Client messaging is the only external send in the MVP and requires darklion:communicate, strict staff visibility, no attachments, audit, and idempotency; QBO writes, third-party syncs, AI generation, bulk operations, and administrative configuration remain excluded.

operations.rationale: Adds staff-scoped daily conversation summaries not present in the current inbox tools.
operations.security_behavior: Preserve getScopedSummaryStaffUserId and remove threads involving the authenticated staff member.

operations.rationale: Useful detail read through a dedicated adapter that does not mutate viewed state.
operations.security_behavior: ISO date only; preserve staff filtering and keep the MCP read side-effect free.
